parameters.name: DeployRegionId
parameters.description: The deployment region ID, which is the region ID where the resource resides.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the application group.

parameters.name: ImportTagKey
parameters.description: The tag key. You must specify both ImportTagKey and ImportTagValue, or leave both empty. You cannot specify only one of them. If neither ImportTagKey nor ImportTagValue is specified, the default value is app-{ApplicationName} (the application name).

parameters.name: ImportTagValue
parameters.description: The tag value. You must specify both ImportTagKey and ImportTagValue, or leave both empty. You cannot specify only one of them. If neither ImportTagKey nor ImportTagValue is specified, the default value is {Name} (the application group name).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the application group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Only cn-hangzhou is supported.
